description: Given a company domain or name, return the contactable role-based email addresses discovered for that organization (such as contact@, sales@, support@), each with a confidence level. Use this for reaching a company inbox, not a specific named person (for a named person use find_people or find_linkedin_profile). Spends 2 credits, refunded if none are found.

domain_or_company.description: A company domain (preferred, e.g. acme.com) or company name.

name: find_company_emails
title: Find a company's emails
